questions.explanation: ANA is highly sensitive for SLE, although it is not specific. Anti-Smith is highly specific but less sensitive; anti-dsDNA is also relatively specific and can correlate with nephritis.

optionExplanations.A: ANA is the most sensitive screening test for SLE, although it lacks specificity.
optionExplanations.B: Anti-Smith antibody is highly specific for SLE but is less sensitive.
optionExplanations.C: Anti-dsDNA is relatively specific and is associated with lupus nephritis, but is less sensitive than ANA.
optionExplanations.D: ESR is nonspecific and cannot establish SLE.
